intro.desktop: Rivals is a deckbuilding boardgame based on a Battle Royale gameplay. You play the chosen one of your clan and fight to save your people from extinction.
intro.mobile: Rivals is a deckbuilding boardgame based on a Battle Royale gameplay.

utopiales.title: The Utopiales 2022
utopiales.descriptif: Come try Rivals in one of the greatest Sci-Fi Festival in France.

arttoplay.title: Art To Play 2022
arttoplay.descriptif: A2P is coming, come meet us.

affiches.title: New Posters !
affiches.descriptif: Have a look at our brand new Rivals posters !

description.title: At the dawn of 3221
description.texte: Humanity is all over the galaxy. After centuries of research, science finally unraveled the secret of hyperspeed.
description.texte2: The Network, supreme political council, sealed the destiny of all clans. In order to avoid the conflicts and wars to come, each clans located on each planet of the Milky Way will designate an Ashak to stand for them in the WildTech, a hybrid arena : half-real, half-digital.
description.texte3: You embody one of these Ashaks and will carry your clan's hopes. The ultimate battle is yet to come and no one wants to discover what is hiding beyond the void.

gameplay.deckbuilding.description: + than 150 cards to build a competitive deck.
gameplay.battleroyale.description: The WildTech, a half-real, half-digital arena, is made of 42 tiles.

pirate.cybernetique.name: Cyber hacking
pirate.cybernetique.descriptif: Discard one card from your target's hand.

battle.royale.description2: Build an arsenal worthy of the name, anticipate the evolutions of the game and adapt to the tricks of your oponents !  Camper or clinch, advanced weapons or psychic powers, what strategies will you adopt ?
battle.royale.description3: Last survivor in the arena or first player to earn all the Rivals points ? Save your clan, history is written by the winners.

gameplay.intro: Rivals is played in several rounds, each divided into two rounds of play. During their turn, players have 2 action points to move, collect resources from a tile, play cards from their hand and interact with sponsors.

description.1: Follow the state of your opponents by consulting their boards. Health points, Ultimate charge, available Skills, take these elements into account to adapt your strategy.
description.2: Add Skills to your Ashak board to develop your power, increase your actions and your draw.

description1.part2: Explore, move and reap the tiles to prepare for your confrontations by refining your deck and building a solid defense! Don't overlook resources, they can save your life and win the game.

description2.part3: says unpredictability. Map tiles are never laid out the same way. Events will spice up the game! It's up to you to take advantage of it. At the end of each round, areas are disintegrated with everything it contained... Staying on the edge of the WildTech can prove fatal, but to venture into it too deeply too.

description3.part3: will appear ! Reach those fierce merchants first to get victory points and bonuses like unique cards. Once the transaction is complete, these disappear for fear of getting caught in the crossfire.

exploration.description: The Ashak can reveal all the tiles adjacent to the hex he is on.

move.action: Grab the Ashak token and move it.
move.description: Ashaks move from hex to hex. A move costs 1 action point and is limited to 2 hexes.

finish.text: You have looted all the tiles. At this rate you better come face the other Ashaks by joining the next Rivals on Discord and Tabletop Simulator !

grenade.flash.title: Grenade: Flash
grenade.flash.description: during their next turn, the wounded ashaks roll a dice before each action. if it is unsuccessful, the action is cancelled and AP are lost.

bone.cracker.title: Bone Cracker
bone.cracker.description: Move 1 hex towards your target before your attack unless you are on the same hex.

fin.stratege.title: Strategist
fin.stratege.description: Draw 2 cards then discard one card.

aura.magnetique.title: Magnetic aura
aura.magnetique.description: Until the beginning of your turn, when you are wounded, ignore 1HP loss.

expert.topo.title: topographic expert
expert.topo.description: +1AP to loot, move or interact with a sponsor.

maitre.des.echos.title: Master of echoes
maitre.des.echos.description: draw 1 additionnal card at the beginning of each round.

1.name: Cyber hacking
1.description: This knowledge is legislated by the laws of the network. Only the Ashaks or the representatives of the order can legally make use of it. It was invented by the Naomancers, a very distant clan of Kelud, it is also quite rare for a Keludian to practice it.
1.action: discard 1 random card from your target's hand.

2.name: cyberspace slum
2.description: Although born on Kelud, Qikaa spent much of her young life in the rubble of cyberspace. There she discovered the intricacies of technology.
2.action: Pay 1 resource unit then install 1 card among the 3 cards at the top of the interface.

qikaa.quote: Luck ? I never had to use that…
qikaa.description: From an early age, Qikaa has played with rules and prohibitions to lead a wandering existence. This life has given her great knowledge and self-confidence. With a quick and resourceful mind, she always got out of the worst situations.

orus.quote: A victory without challenge has a bitter taste.
orus.description: A veteran of Helgafell, a more than inhospitable planet where survival is an art, Orus has distinguished himself throughout his life by numerous achievements. His experience allows him to always keep his cool and establish the best strategy to lead him to victory.

1.name: water hammer
1.action: Reduce your max range by 2. +1 damage.
1.description: Reduce your max range by 2. +1 damage.

2.name: Cheetah Leap
2.action: Teleport to the same hex as your target then inflict 2 damage.
2.description: Teleport to the same hex as your target then inflict 2 damage.

atmos.description: In addition to being part of the first generations to innately master therianthropy, Atmos does not seem limited in the amount of transformation. Acting as a double agent among the Network's elite, he is tasked by his Clan with judging whether the time has come for the Shapeshifters to resurface. Allocentric, his appointment to the Rivals as Ashak upsets his vision of the world. He must now prepare to think of himself before others.

2.name: Digital cloning
2.action: get 1 resource unit you already own.
2.description: get 1 resource unit you already own.

xhan.quote: One is all. All is one..
xhan.description: Nicknamed "Hope of the Nation" after overthrowing the former dictatorial regime of his people, Xhan Banut is a renowned scientist with many hats. His devotion to his clan is powerful and whatever the outcome of the coming battles, he will always be one step ahead.

1.name: dark bramble
1.action: choose 1 ashak on a tile with a forest, it loses 1VP. If he is on the forest space, he loses 2VP instead.
1.description: choose 1 ashak on a tile with a forest, it loses 1VP. If he is on the forest space, he loses 2VP instead.

2.name: Tree protection
2.action: Until the start of your next turn, if you are on a tile with a forest, you can re-roll each of your dodge dice once.
2.description: Until the start of your next turn, if you are on a tile with a forest, you can re-roll each of your dodge dice once.

yosh.description: The Network has very little information relating to Clan Purplebark. They are among the clans that have diverged the most from the initial human biological state. This powerful evolution granted them the ability to manipulate nature, giving them a huge advantage and many surprise effects.

1.name: Essaim de flashers
1.action: Placez 1 flasher dans le deck de votre cible. Vous pouvez répéter cet effet sur une autre cible.
1.description: Les flashers sont une création de Renko. Conçu au départ à des fins pacifistes, il a détourné leur usage à l'annonce du Rivals. Les Flashers sont aujourd'hui de véritables parasites mortels.

2.name: Drone d'accélération
2.action: Votre cible vous révèle les 3 cartes du dessus de son deck et active tous les flashers révélés. Si votre cible possède au moins 1 flasher, elle perd 1PV sinon piochez 1 carte.
2.description: D'un naturel calme, Renko prend toujours son temps et prépare ses coups minutieusement. Une fois ses flashers bien placés, il frappe un grand coup.

ulti.name: Flashers mortels
ulti.description: Ne vous laissez pas parasiter par les Flashers. Plus vicieux que des insectes, ils ne vous laisseront aucunes chances.
ulti.action: +1 portée max jusqu'à la fin de la manche. Activez 1 flasher sur votre cible. Tous les flashers de ce joueur sont révélés et activés puis votre cible mélange son deck et sa défausse.

renko.description: Bien que né sur Nama, Renko est l'ashak de Dronus, une planète végétale connut pour la pureté de ses eaux. De parents Namis il a hérité de fortes capacités naturelles en microrobotique.
